_meta.datasheet_section: §6 pin functions; §7.1 absolute maximum ratings; §7.5 electrical characteristics
_meta.notes: Reverse current blocking (V(IN) < V(OUT) − 66 mV). EN/UVLO and OVP thresholds 0.99 V rising (OVP 0.92 V falling). I(dVdT) 1 µA, GAIN(dVdT) 11.9 V/V. R(ILIM) 88.7 kΩ → 0.99 A (0.9–1.07). IQ(OFF) 6–20 µA at V(IN) 12 V. Auto-retry.
